name: Interview Evaluation Note
description: Template for recording candidate information, interview responses, and structured evaluation for hiring decisions.

sections.title: Interview Metadata
sections.instruction: Date, Time, Candidate Name, Position Applied For, Interviewer(s) Name

sections.title: Candidate Profile
sections.instruction: Brief summary of candidate's background and current status (e.g., notice period, salary expectations)

sections.title: Competency Assessment
sections.instruction: Evaluation of technical skills, soft skills, and role-specific competencies.

sections.title: Key Responses & Observations
sections.instruction: Detailed notes on specific questions asked and the candidate's responses.

sections.title: Culture Fit & Values
sections.instruction: Assessment of how the candidate aligns with company values and team dynamics.

sections.title: Strengths & Weaknesses
sections.instruction: Summary of key strengths and potential areas of concern/risks.

sections.title: Final Recommendation
sections.instruction: Decision: Hire, No Hire, or Hold. Include rationale for the decision.

sections.title: Next Steps / Action Items
sections.instruction: Follow-up tasks (e.g., background check, second round scheduling, reference checks)
